raw:
Let me analyze this task. The app displays a remark under tonight's sleep numbers (one line).

Tonight's data:
- Time in bed: 7 hours 50 minutes
- Time asleep: 6 hours 20 minutes
- Time to fall asleep: 48 minutes
- Woke 3 times
- User's goal: 7 hours asleep
- Past 7 days average time to fall asleep: 15 minutes

The remark should be one line, factual, no chatty phrasing, no apologies, no exclamation marks, no disclaimers about how numbers were calculated, no "約/大概" since values are already estimates, no "我們", no "你的/您的" unless needed, no repeating title info, no explaining obvious things, no mainland China terminology (當前、默認、設置、數據、視頻、用戶、緩存、軟件、網絡、信息), no periods at end of labels/buttons, keep it short.

Key contrasts worth noting:
- Sleep duration 6h20m vs goal 7h → 40 minutes short
- Sleep latency 48 min vs 7-day average 15 min → much longer than usual

The remark should be informative, one line. Something like:

「睡眠時間較目標少 40 分鐘，入睡時間較近 7 日平均長 33 分鐘」

Wait — "過去 7 天入睡時間平均 15 分鐘" — the remark shouldn't repeat numbers already shown? The title shows the sleep numbers (在床、睡著、入睡時間、清醒次數 presumably). The goal is user-set. The 7-day average 15 min is not shown, so mentioning it adds value.

Rules: Don't repeat what title already said. So "睡著 6 小時 20 分" is already displayed; the remark should add context: comparison to goal and to recent average.

Something like:
「睡眠時間低於目標，入睡時間明顯長於近 7 日平均」

Or with numbers:
「較目標少 40 分鐘，入睡時間為近 7 日平均的 3 倍」

Hmm, "僅供參考" disclaimers are banned. Avoid "約". Avoid questioning.

Compute: goal 7h = 420 min; asleep 6h20m = 380 min; shortfall = 40 min. Latency 48 vs 15 → 33 min longer.

One line remark in Traditional Chinese (the prompt uses Traditional Chinese with 台灣 usage — use 睡眠、入睡、平均、過去 7 天; avoid 數據/信息 etc.).

Possible: 「睡眠時間較目標少 40 分鐘，入睡時間較過去 7 天平均多 33 分鐘」

That's concise, factual, no "你的". But is "你的" needed to distinguish goal? The goal is user-set; but "目標" suffices without possessive since it's singular context.

Length: fine. No period at end. JSON only.

Check banned words: 當前 no, 默認 no, 設置 no, 數據 no, 信息 no, 用戶 no. Good.

Don't defend numbers, no disclaimers. Good.

Should I mention waking 3 times? The count is likely already displayed ("清醒 3 次"). Don't repeat.

Also avoid "約". Use exact numbers — all inputs are precise.

Final: {"remark":"睡眠時間較目標少 40 分鐘，入睡時間較過去 7 天平均多 33 分鐘"}

That's one line, short, informative. Alternatively could be slightly shorter: "少了目標 40 分鐘，入睡較近 7 日平均長 33 分鐘". The first version is clean.

JSON only output.</think>{"remark":"睡眠時間較目標少 40 分鐘，入睡時間較過去 7 天平均多 33 分鐘"}
